summary: Namco's 1995 System 22 motorcycle racer with linked-cabinet multiplayer, selectable bikes, route-style circuits, and hidden motorcycles.

entries.title: Cyber Cycles

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware; linked cabinets are needed for the intended four-player setup.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Namco System 22 arcade presentation with linked-cabinet multiplayer on original hardware

primary.why: Cyber Cycles is sourced as a 1995 Namco arcade racing game on System 22 hardware, with Arcade as its only documented platform. Its linked cabinets support up to four simultaneous players, and no home port or alternate release is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use linked two-player cabinets where available for four-player races.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Namco System 22 arcade release with linked-cabinet support for up to four players.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced platform route; no secondary content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced home port or remaster.
